spec.description: Autex Global's Grid Ceiling Tiles are acoustic solutions designed to elevate traditional ceiling grid systems, featuring carbon neutrality, zero carbon manufacturing, and high recycled content.
spec.fire: Class A, FS:0 - SD:45, ISO 9705: Classification: Group 1-S
spec.sustainability: EPD – compliant with ISO 14025 and EN 15804, Declare – Red List free, ISO 14001 Certified Environmental Management
install: Install as per Autex Acoustics recommendations
Install instructions included in each pack or available on the website
Consult project engineer and fire protection engineer for installation near fire protection systems
limitations: Grid Ceiling Tiles are made from Cube as the base material
Grid Ceiling Tiles are suitable for indoor use only
Light fastness is dependent on use and exposure
Non-woven. Product may vary from samples and batch to batch
Blot spills from fabric quickly. Wipe with a damp cloth. Avoid rubbing and excessive amounts of water
Custom printed Grid Ceiling Tiles require specialist cleaning
